title: k-Nearest Points & k-Way Sensor Merge with priority_queue
hints: kNearest: a MAX-heap of `std::pair<double,int>` (squared distance, index) of size ≤ k. Its top is the worst of the current best k.
Push while size < k; otherwise replace the top only if `std::make_pair(d2, i) < heap.top()`. Comparing pairs gives the index tie-break for free.
Pop everything into a vector (worst first) and `std::reverse` it.
mergeStreams: min-heap of `std::tuple<double, std::size_t, std::size_t>` = (t, stream, position) with `std::greater<>`; pop the smallest, then push the next element from the same stream.
